अक्षय कुमार अब आ रहे हैं एक खतरनाक एलियन खतरे के साथ! 👽
फिल्ममेकर विपुल अमृतलाल शाह के साथ अक्षय कुमार की जोड़ी एक बार फिर से लौट आई है।
सामने आए मोशन पोस्टर में अक्षय मिलिट्री वाले रग्ड लुक में हाथ में राइफल लिए नजर आ रहे हैं।
पोस्टर की टैगलाइन 'The Mission is Human but The Enemy Isn’t' है, जो एलियन खतरे का इशारा करती है।
मेकर्स के मुताबिक यह फिल्म सिनेमाघरों में 28 मई 2027 को रिलीज होगी। 🎬
आज दोपहर 2:00 बजे एक और बड़ा ऐलान होने वाला है।
इससे पहले यह जोड़ी Aankhen, Waqt, Namastey London और Singh Is Kinng जैसी फिल्मों में साथ काम कर चुकी है।
क्या आप अक्षय कुमार को इस नए sci-fi अवतार में देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇

ctx.text:
The actor reunites with filmmaker Vipul Amrutlal Shah for a creature-driven action spectacle, with the makers teasing another major announcement at 2 PM today.
Akshay Kumar is stepping into the world of science fiction with Samuk , his upcoming collaboration with filmmaker Vipul Amrutlal Shah. After the reunion between the actor and producer-director was officially announced, the makers have now released an atmospheric motion poster, offering the first glimpse into the film’s extraterrestrial premise. The visual reveal also confirms the film’s theatrical release date, setting the stage for what appears to be a survival-driven action thriller.
The motion poster features Akshay Kumar in a rugged, military-style avatar, holding a rifle as he faces the ominous silhouette of what appears to be an extraterrestrial creature’s hand. The contrast between the human figure and the unidentified presence establishes the central conflict suggested by the film’s first promotional material. Accompanying the visual is the tagline, ‘The Mission is Human but The Enemy Isn’t’, hinting at a mission in which human survival and tactical resilience will be tested against an unknown threat.
The makers have confirmed that Samuk will arrive in cinemas worldwide on May 28, 2027. They have also announced that another major update about the film will be unveiled today at 2:00 PM. While the nature of the announcement has not yet been disclosed, it has added another element of anticipation around the project. Further details about the cast, characters and story are awaited, with the upcoming reveal potentially offering a clearer picture of the film’s scale and narrative.
One predator. One mission. A fight that has no rules. #SAMUK unveils at 2:07 PM. Stay Tuned! https://t.co/xNhr9qAVp8
Samuk also brings Akshay Kumar and Vipul Amrutlal Shah together again after a series of successful collaborations across different genres. The duo has previously worked on films such as Aankhen , Waqt: The Race Against Time , Namastey London , Singh Is Kinng and Action Replayy . Their association has covered comedy, drama, romance and action, while their latest project takes them into the science-fiction space.
The motion poster suggests that the film will combine military action with a creature-based premise, marking a different genre outing for the actor. Akshay’s rugged appearance and the suggestion of an alien adversary point towards a narrative built around a confrontation between humans and an unfamiliar force.
With its release date now locked and another announcement scheduled for the afternoon, Samuk has begun revealing details of its cinematic world. Audiences will have to wait for the next update to learn more about the film’s cast and the story behind its human-versus-extraterrestrial conflict.
